shots.content: Rainy riverside settlement at dawn; wooden landing, wet bamboo baskets, extinguished paper lamps; ripples; open center walkway; no people.
Frayed rope slides along a wet wooden landing; small parcel presses against the edge; rope catches on a bamboo peg; no human hands.
Rain-wet bronze bell shape visible only in the water reflection beneath a wooden pier; no bell above the water; one ripple interrupts the shape.
shots.panelDefect: Storyboard panel draws the bell SOLID under the pier with a reflection below, against the pack (reflection only, no bell above water). Final picture must fix this; the defect is kept visible here, not silently corrected.

shots.content: Five-groove seal on a closed rain-dark envelope in the courier's open satchel; one drop runs across the wax; seal intact; letter content not shown.
Ly An kneels to stop a small wooden parcel sliding toward water; looks toward an offscreen helper, not at camera.

dialogue.speaker: NPC_LYAN
dialogue.text: Đầu kia! Giữ giúp tôi đầu kia!

shots.content: Top-down rainy landing matching Ben Mua entry composition; small parcel secured beside the wooden post; Ly An stands just north of the safe player arrival space; last second motionless for handoff; no player avatar.
shots.panelDefect: Storyboard figure reads as the warden (topknot, dark robe) rather than Ly An. Final picture must draw Ly An here per the questkit reference.
stemPlan: SFX/CINEMA/reveal as scene-level stinger, position pending picture lock

shots.content: Three concentric ripple patterns drift toward the same submerged stone channel; small reed leaf turns upstream; rain falls normally; camera still at water level.
Ta Van Khanh lowers his good hand toward water and stops before touching it; bandaged arm, broken sword on his back; no flashback image.

dialogue.sceneNote: Window is scene-local (CIN_002 runs 0-18s in its own timeline); shot-local 1.0-5.0s.
dialogue.speaker: NPC_TA_VAN_KHANH
dialogue.text: Trên bờ chỉ nghe nửa tiếng. Phần còn lại ở dưới ấy.

shots.content: Strict top-down view of the same reed bank and stone channel; ripples stop at a hairline crack; readable calm surface for the gameplay transition.
Bone-scaled swamp serpent Mang Cot raises its broken-horned head beside a blocked stone watercourse; rain-blue moss on its segmented neck; pained, heavy movement.
shots.panelDefect: Broken-horn detail is not clearly readable in the storyboard panel; final picture must show exactly one broken horn per canon.

shots.content: Distorted current presses against the serpent ribs; pale reed fragments travel the wrong way; serpent recoils from the current, not from an unseen sword.

dialogue.sceneNote: Window is scene-local (CIN_004 runs 0-18s in its own timeline); shot-local 1.5-3.5s. Off-screen status is DECIDED; placement is PROPOSED.
dialogue.speaker: NPC_LYAN
dialogue.text: Nó cứ tránh chỗ nước ấy.
